name: doc-hero
purpose: The masthead of a documentation home: a display-size `h1`, a deck capped at a readable measure, an action row (the primary `Get started`, then `CopyPromptButton`) and one muted note under it that says what the prompt does. It carries the air the home needs — `--spacing-2xl` above and below, `--spacing-xl` between the deck and the actions — so the front door reads as a front door and not as one more article. An article page uses `DocPageHeader` instead.
useWhen: Use DocHero only on the documentation home; marketing page openings use HeroSection.
The top of a documentation home or a docs section landing (`shell/shell-docs`, variant `Landing`).
avoidWhen: On an article or reference page → use `DocPageHeader` (breadcrumb, last updated, page actions).
On the marketing site → use `Hero` or a page section.
related: `CopyPromptButton` — the second action of the row.
`DocAgentCard` — the agent card that usually opens the first section under the hero.
bestPractices: Keep the title short (`Welcome to Azion Docs`) and the deck to one or two sentences.
Put `Button variant="primary" size="large"` first and `CopyPromptButton` second in `#actions`; say what the prompt does in `#note`.
Do not wrap it in `DocProse`; it is page chrome (`data-doc-chrome`).

props.name: title
props.doc: The page title, set at display size as the page's `h1`.

props.name: description
props.doc: The deck under the title: what the docs cover, in one or two sentences.

slots.name: title
slots.notes: Replaces the title text, for a title that is more than a string.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: The action row: the primary `Button` first, then `CopyPromptButton`.

slots.name: note
slots.notes: One muted line under the actions that says what the prompt does.
